SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000792
DOCKET NO. F 004412 25 CTL# 163196
PLAINTIFF – PHH MORTGAGE CORPORATION
DEFENDANTS- KELLY S. CAHILL ET ALS
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 25th DAY OF August 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Borough of Pompton Lakes, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax LOT 5 BLOCK 11600
Dimensions of Lot: 0.23 ACRE
Nearest Cross Street: Elm Avenue
Estimated upset bid amount: $487,000.00, plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $3,963.00 OPEN
Vacant Lot Charge: Property registration fees exist. Please contact township clerk at 973-835-0143 ext 238
Sewer: Pompton Lakes MUA 2000 Lincoln Ave. Pompton Lakes, NJ 07442 973-839-3044 Acct: 542548 04/01/2026 - 06/30/2026 $130.00 OPEN
Water: Pompton Lakes MUA 2000 Lincoln Ave. Pompton Lakes, NJ 07442 973-839-3044 Acct: 542548 01/01/2026 - 03/31/2026 $72.00 OPEN
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
227 Poplar Avenue Pompton Lakes, NJ 07442-1618
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $449,017.19 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: August 3, 2026
RAS, PLLC
130 Clinton Road
Suite 202
Fairfield, NJ 07004
973-575-0707
